scope.summary: Implement piping edge treatment (CG-11, MD Piping): rounded piping geometry generated along garment edges (radius, fabric/material ref, closed-end caps per MD 2024.2) as a solver-coupled edge trim following the deformed edge each substep, sibling of ElasticInsert/BindingTape (MT-371) per Section 13.8.
acceptance_criteria: PipingSpec (edge span, radius_mm, material ref, closed_end: bool) generates a swept tube mesh along the edge polyline, rebuilt from deformed edge positions per frame (render/export geometry, collision optional off by default).
trim_category CHECK domain extended with 'piping' (migration follows MT-371's category-extension pattern).
Piping survives refit (re-generated along the refitted edge, MT-304 pattern) and exports in all mesh lanes with its own material slot.
place_piping exposed via the trim MCP surface (MT-263 family).
scope.risk_if_missed: Piped edges are ubiquitous in lingerie/corsetry/upholstery-style garments; absent piping forces fake texture lines that break closeups.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; GUI exposure rides the existing Tailor panels and is validated there.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > Trims, closures, and rigid attachments

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT emits typed diagnostics through its owning command or job and inherits retention, health, and projection behavior from the shared diagnostics substrate.
The owning native shell or scheduled job supplies Palmistry coverage; this MT must preserve operation identity and recovery handles.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Replace contradictory CPU/GPU trim ownership with the per-tier interaction matrix and require final two-way generalized-coordinate coupling where the selected profile needs it.
Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.

requirements: Resolve Principal, AuthenticatedSession and AccessSpace before every resource read or mutation.
Use PostgreSQL RLS/FORCE RLS and ResourceBroker-backed artifact/file handles; UI filtering is never the security boundary.
Derived resources preserve the intersection of source access scopes and must not leak existence through counts, search, previews, logs, traces, caches, diagnostics, exports or model context.
